intent.caption: Particle constellation hero — A deep starfield of instanced points with depth falloff and an accent core, slow drift, additive glow discipline.

textContent.text: Precision instruments for the dark hours.

visualSpec.effects: 1200 instanced icosahedron points, each radius 0.012 scene units, distributed through an ellipsoidal shell 6 x 4 x 5 units centered at [0,0,-1.5]. Depth falloff: per-instance opacity 0.9 at z=0 falling linearly to 0.15 at z=-5; linear fog #0b0b10 near 4 far 10 so far points sink into the stage. Accent core: 90 instances within a 0.5-unit-radius sphere at origin tinted #ff2a38 with emissive #ff2a38 intensity 1.8 (additive blending only inside the core, hard cap, no screen-space soft blur). Field particles are paper #e8ecf2 at metalness 0, roughness 1, self-lit 0.9. particle-emerge on load: instances scale 0 to 1 and translate outward from the core to final anchors over 1400ms, staggered by distance-from-core, cubic-bezier(0.165,0.84,0.44,1). Ambient drift: each particle orbits its anchor +/-0.04 units at 0.05 Hz on offset phase. Core pulse: emissive intensity 1.5 to 1.8 sine at 0.1 Hz. Hero MSDF type plane at z=0.5, baseline 0.5 units (2x base) above center; subhead 0.75 units below hero baseline; caption pinned 2.25 units below center on the 0.25-unit rhythm.

sceneSpec.motionNote: Particles emerge outward from the accent core over 1.4s, then drift slowly on offset phases while the red core pulses at 0.1 Hz.
